body: Plumbline suite leftovers (bin/, hooks/, docs/, ceremony/, practice-definitions.md, package.json, LICENSE, .DS_Store) count as unchanged when they carry their suite mark (a 'Materialized by ok' stamp on the last line or in the first five, the lint's const VERSION line, the LICENSE preamble, package.json's fixed bytes, a TOC's '(auto-generated)' heading) and no uncommitted change: the old payload no longer ships, so 'differs from the suite's copy' cannot be measured byte for byte. An unmarked, dirty, or symlinked one is an estate-edits offer whose Show: prints git diff HEAD or a diff against the current payload counterpart.

worktrees: offer fires on registered worktrees under the profile's dirPrefix or local branches under branchPrefix (listed from refs/heads/ and filtered by prefix; an empty prefix matches none). Other content in the worktree directory is an estate-leftover offer (delete only), and the estate's .gitignore stays while it stands (linescout's .ok-workspaces/worktrees/.cache takes this path). While the worktrees offer stands, the core removes nothing from .ok-workspaces/ and the retired-script offers wait.

Kept workspaces scripts are recognized at the profile's runTag.path and srcTag.path and at .ok-workspaces/bin/{run-tag,src-tag,port-block}; the profile is kept while port-block stands or while it names a run-tag path outside the estate, so a declined retired-script offer comes back on every run. Other workspaces removals (profile, config.proposed.json, LICENSE, ceremony/, hooks/, context/, .gitignore, .DS_Store, a stamped custom-prefix ignore file) need no suite stamp, go by git rm where tracked, and become estate-edits offers when dirty or behind a link. A workspaces leftover offers delete only (no new home); a plumbline leftover offers move to the same path under .ok-planner/ or delete.

The live-sprint mechanism is admin/converge::SPRINT_LINE_REWRITES, exact whole-line (old, new) pairs applied to .ok-planner/sprints/*.md only (never history/, never the -deltas/ sidecar), reported by diagnose and applied by the new 'corpus' mode. Rows are the base boilerplate lines of sprint-document.md and _sprint/shared.md naming .ok-plumbline/ paths, path-substituted; besides B123's subject, practice, and catalog-toc lines it carries the build prompt's events-standard line, which goes stale with the same move. Later stages append their rows (t14: the execute-tasks line). Rows are built from a PLUMBLINE_DIR constant, as are the retired script paths, so the core never names the old lint or catalog-toc path literally and script-path never offers the suite's own core in this repository.

I6: one helper, admin/converge::write_owner (realpath, mkstemp beside the real file, mode kept or umask default, os.replace, temp removed in finally). To route every owner-file write through it, the bash review_config heredoc moved into vendor_layer as mode 'review-config' (seed/check/fix, same output lines), and the contract, falsifier, and decision-proof heredocs moved into a 'corpus' mode with the live-sprint rewrite (same messages, same place in the run). The review config rewrite swaps the JSON-encoded strings and keeps the result only when it parses to the intended config, so every other byte stays; when an exclude or block_sources change rides along it falls back to the re-dump those rewrites always used. Left outside the helper: the bash cp that seeds a new project.md (create only) and catalog-toc's TOC writes (a separate script).

A TOC whose .ok-planner/ path is already taken is removed as a generated suite file when clean.
